I'll let Base know our call sign is Landkiller One.|An [[Unidentified Imperial sergeant training instructor|Imperial training instructor]]|<ref name="When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
'''Landkiller One''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] assigned to a modified training [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
